description: Opens/attaches a TIA project (.ap*) on the serve host. Class M-off. Idempotent for the ALREADY-OPEN project (response `alreadyOpen:true`, no-op) and reuses a running TIA instance for a DIFFERENT project (`reusedPortal:true`). In an instance serve started, the open project and any foreign project are closed to make room (or the instance is restarted): if one has unsaved changes the call is REFUSED with 409 `unsaved_changes` and nothing is changed, unless it carries `saveUnsavedChanges:true` (saves each modified project first; recommended) or `discardUnsavedChanges:true` (closes WITHOUT saving: DATA LOSS, only on an explicit human decision, never to get past the refusal; the client asks the human to confirm first). `closedForeign` lists the foreign projects that were closed, `savedProjects`/`discardedProjects` the ones saved or discarded; an instance you had open yourself is never closed (serve only detaches). The response carries `boundProjectPath` (the project this session is bound to) and `modified` (unsaved changes); a later operation answers 409 `binding_conflict` if the project open in the bound TIA changed meanwhile (call tia_connect again to rebind). `withUserInterface` only applies when a NEW instance is started (ignored when reusing one — see tia_show_ui to change an existing instance's visibility). WARNING: the 1st connection per `serve` process can BLOCK on the trust GATE (G1) — if the dialog hasn't been confirmed, this tool does NOT retry-storm: it returns a `requires_human_action` envelope (gate trust_dialog, with resumeToken) asking a human to confirm the dialog on the host. Proactive flow: tia_start → tia_show_ui → (human confirms) → tia_connect. UMAC (umacUser/umacPassword) is GATE G6: provide it ONLY if a human gave the credentials — NEVER make them up. Maps to POST /connect. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.

discardUnsavedChanges.description: DATA LOSS: close the modified project(s) WITHOUT saving; every unsaved change is lost for good. Only when a human explicitly decided to throw that work away, NEVER to get past an unsaved_changes refusal. Never together with saveUnsavedChanges.

projectPath.description: path to the project file (.ap*) on the serve host (required)

resumeToken.description: token returned by the GATE handoff; re-call with it AFTER a human has confirmed the dialog

saveUnsavedChanges.description: RECOMMENDED choice when a modified project would be closed: save every modified project this call closes, then close it. Without a flag such a call is refused with unsaved_changes and nothing is changed. Never together with discardUnsavedChanges.

umacPassword.description: UMAC password (GATE G6; only if a human provided it — never make it up)

umacUser.description: UMAC user (GATE G6; only if a human provided it — never make it up)

withUserInterface.description: open with the TIA UI visible (default true)

name: tia_connect
title: TIA — connect/open project (trust GATE G1)
